answer: Because the dawn weight is recomputed from the velvet history each close, the meadow audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 10 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 40% of full weight. Running a farm as a result buys partial influence at full price for each duplicate self, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
